tools.name: imprint_add
tools.description: Add a new imprint rule. Use only after gatekeeper classification ADD. path is the shard file (imprint-NNNN.md), not a per-rule filename.

tools.name: imprint_find
tools.description: Recall imprints by scope (preferred) and optional lexical query.

tools.name: imprint_supersede
tools.description: Replace an old rule. Archives the old record and writes a new one.

tools.name: imprint_get
tools.description: Full record by id, including evidence_log.

tools.name: imprint_sweep
tools.description: Decay untouched rules and archive those below the dormant threshold.

tools.name: imprint_viz
tools.description: Generate an HTML dashboard (default) or mermaid graph of the vault.
